verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the edges of this story. The founder says the Gmail API integration gives faster real-time updates and latency compensation, and one user cleared their inbox quickly, which suggests a responsive interface. The only keyboard interaction documented is pressing 'tab' to accept Ghostwriter autocomplete. Missing for 10: any documentation of a comprehensive keyboard shortcut set, a command palette, keyboard-only navigation and triage, and independent hands-on corroboration of speed.
